name: flashes-floaters-good
description: Well-handled call: full introduction, asks what she is noticing, when it started, which eye and pain; same-day optometrist with the reason and a safety net.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Good morning, is that the surgery? I'd like to book a routine appointment with the doctor, please.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Good morning, Pen-y-Bryn Surgery, Sam speaking. Can I take your name please?

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you Delyth. And is the appointment for yourself?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, it's for me. It's something in my eye.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Can you tell me a bit more about what you are noticing in the eye?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Well, I've been seeing flashing lights, and there are some little black specks, like cobwebs, floating about.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: This morning. It came on quite suddenly.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Is it in one eye or both? And is it painful?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Only my left eye, and it doesn't hurt.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: Thank you for telling me that, Delyth. Sudden flashes and new floaters need looking at today, so I don't want to book you a routine appointment. I'm going to arrange for you to be seen by an optometrist today. It's an urgent eye assessment, and I'll give you the details now.

transcript.speaker: trainee
transcript.text: It's best to have it checked today, that's all. If anything changes before then, or your sight gets worse, ring us straight back.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Right, thank you. I'll do that.

expect.flagsReason: Same-day optometrist matches the key; the red flag was drawn out and acted on.

greeting.reason: Own name, practice, caller name, for whom.

information.reason: Unlocked flashes, floaters, sudden onset, one eye and no pain.

redFlag.reason: Spotted and acted on at once.

explanation.reason: Where, why (needs looking at today) and ring back if worse.

manner.reason: Calm, kind, clear with a worried caller.
